title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
summary: Patrick Lewis and coauthors submitted 'Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks' on May 22, 2020. The paper introduces RAG models that combine a pre-trained sequence-to-sequence model as parametric memory with a dense vector index of Wikipedia accessed through a neural retriever as non-parametric memory.
significance: A documented research-publication milestone for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) models that jointly use parametric and retrieved non-parametric memory for language generation.
